issue_context.title: [BUG] using terminal to close browser doesn't save storage
issue_context.body:
**Context:**
- Playwright Version:  latest
- Operating System: Mac
- Node.js version:14.17
- Browser: [e.g. All, Chromium, Firefox, WebKit]
- Extra: [any specific details about your environment]

<!-- CLI to auto-capture this info -->
<!-- npx envinfo --preset playwright --markdown -->

**Code Snippet**

````npx playwright codegen --save-storage=auth.json github.com````

Login int Github then close codegen using the terminal

````npx playwright codegen --load-storage=auth.json github.com````

Not logged in 

**Describe the bug**

After signing into GitHub when you close codegen using the terminal instead of directly closing the browser then the storage is not saved.
